**Audience:** HR and workforce planning

**Incident:** Synthetic pump fire · 2024-03-20

## Bottom line

- No competence standard said who may sign off a pressure-boundary seal change. [FND-0002; EVD-0002] *(learning: LR-01)*

## About this pack

Learnings about systems, not individuals' records.

## People-system learnings

### Qualification and authorisation

**Learning:** A seal change on a pressure boundary needs a task authorisation, not only a job title. [FND-0002; EVD-0002]

The procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002], so nothing defined who was competent to sign the job off.

- Owner: Competence-framework owner

*(learning: LR-01)*

## Competence framework: what to define

| Role | What the export shows | What the framework should define | Cites |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pump technician | Seal changed and restarted without a leak test | Authorisation for seal changes, including the leak test | FND-0001; EVD-0001 |
| Stores/procurement officer | Seals bought locally without a specification | Who may approve a substitute part | FND-0003 |

## Rostering, manning and workload

### Crew and team composition

**Learning:** A pressure-boundary job needs a second person to witness the test. [FND-0001; EVD-0001]

The work order shows no test and no witness [EVD-0001].

- Owner: Workforce planner for maintenance

## Hand-off to training design

For training-designer: the leak test before return to service is a training need; this pack sets the standard. [FND-0001]

## Limits of this pack

- The synthetic export holds nothing on rosters or hours.
